answer: Entropy-Seeded Capability Lottery.** Each identity gets capabilities by hashing a fresh network entropy seed against its key; only a fraction yields useful roles, paid for in compute. Clones multiply identities but each reroll burns electricity on mostly barren outcomes, like bees chasing sparse nectar. A fixed work threshold per useful capability, calibrated to volatile demand (shale-like friction), keeps the marginal clone negative. Genuine operators amortize via stable seeds; sybils pay the lotus of repeated futile hashing.
